title: Refresh record
description: The outcome of the last refresh: when it ran, at which commit, and how every registered generator fared.

started.description: When the refresh began, UTC RFC 3339 with a Z suffix.

finished.description: When the refresh ended, UTC RFC 3339 with a Z suffix.

commit.description: The checkout's HEAD when the refresh ran.

generators.description: One entry per registered kind, in registry order.

generator.description: What one kind's generator did in this refresh.

status.description: Whether the generator's files were published.

count.description: The view files published, and 0 when the generator failed.

error.description: The traceback when the generator failed, null when it succeeded.
